import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 505;
    static int n, m, md;
    static long[] fac = new long[N], inv = new long[N], f = new long[N], g = new long[N];
    static long[][][] dp = new long[N][N][2], dp2 = new long[N][N][2];

    static long add(long x, long y) {
        x += y;
        if (x >= md) x -= md;
        return x;
    }

    static long sub(long x, long y) {
        x -= y;
        if (x < 0) x += md;
        return x;
    }

    static long mul(long x, long y) {
        return (x * y) % md;
    }

    static long fpow(long x, int y) {
        long ans = 1;
        while (y > 0) {
            if ((y & 1) == 1) ans = mul(ans, x);
            y >>= 1;
            x = mul(x, x);
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static long C(int n, int m) {
        return mul(fac[n], mul(inv[m], inv[n - m]));
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        m = sc.nextInt();
        md = sc.nextInt();

        fac[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            fac[i] = mul(fac[i - 1], i);
        }
        inv[n] = fpow(fac[n], md - 2);
        for (int i = n; i >= 1; i--) {
            inv[i - 1] = mul(inv[i], i);
        }

        f[0] = 0;
        g[0] = 1;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                long now = mul(C(i - 1, j - 1), i + 1);
                g[i] = add(g[i], mul(mul(g[j - 1], g[i - j]), now));
                f[i] = add(f[i], mul(mul(f[j - 1], g[i - j]), now));
                f[i] = add(f[i], mul(mul(g[j - 1], f[i - j]), now));
                long temp = (long)(j - 1) * j / 2 + (long)(i - j) * (i - j + 1) / 2;
                f[i] = add(f[i], mul(mul(C(i - 1, j - 1), mul(g[j - 1], g[i - j])), temp));
            }
        }

        dp[0][0][1] = 0;
        dp2[0][0][1] = 1;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
                dp[i][j][1] = add(dp[i - 1][j][0], dp[i - 1][j][1]);
                dp2[i][j][1] = add(dp2[i - 1][j][0], dp2[i - 1][j][1]);
                for (int k = 1; k <= j; k++) {
                    long c = C(j, k);
                    long val1 = mul(dp2[i - k][j - k][1], f[k]);
                    long val2 = mul(dp[i - k][j - k][1], g[k]);
                    long val3 = mul(dp2[i - k][j - k][1], g[k]);
                    dp[i][j][0] = add(dp[i][j][0], mul(c, val1));
                    dp[i][j][0] = add(dp[i][j][0], mul(c, val2));
                    dp2[i][j][0] = add(dp2[i][j][0], mul(c, val3));
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(add(dp[n][m][0], dp[n][m][1]));
        sc.close();
    }
}
